title: Pivot BotSpy from Python to Rust
description: Single Rust library crate (no binary/CLI/server/FFI); Python package, behave, pytest, ruff, python-semantic-release removed; cucumber-rs runs the specs; release-plz replaces python-semantic-release. Done when: cargo test/clippy/fmt are green and CI passes on all targets.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: single Rust library crate (no bin/CLI/server/FFI targets); Python package, behave, pytest, ruff and python-semantic-release configs removed from the tree (only local cache dirs remain, untracked); cucumber-rs runs the specs via tests/bdd.rs; release-plz configured (release-plz.toml). cargo fmt/clippy/test green and CI green on main (only the known release-plz 403 Release failure). The per-target CI matrix is tracked separately as BOTSPY-3fa1b4.

right_now_summary: BotSpy now uses a single Rust library, with green checks and CI except for a known release-plz 403.
